name: dag
description: Interactive directed acyclic graph renderer. Config is either an inline DAG document with schemaVersion, title, nodes, and edges, or exactly one absolute JSON path field: data_file or dataFile. Nodes auto-size within layout min/max bounds; labels and outgoing bend lanes expand connection gaps; omitted edge colors are stably grouped by target node; only connection segments use Braille cells, while arrows use normal terminal glyphs. Oversized graphs can be panned by dragging.
